shortDescription: Update a dynamic secret in Infisical

options.name: auth_method
options.description: The method to use to authenticate with Infisical.

options.name: default_ttl
options.description: The new default time to live for leases. Example values are "1h", "30m", "24h".

options.name: env_slug
options.description: The environment slug where the dynamic secret is located.

options.name: identity_id
options.description: The identity ID of the user that should be authenticated (for OIDC auth).

options.name: inputs
options.description: Updated provider-specific configuration inputs. The structure varies depending on the provider type.

options.name: jwt
options.description: The JWT of the user that should be authenticated (for OIDC auth).

options.name: ldap_password
options.description: The LDAP password used to authenticate (for ldap_auth).

options.name: ldap_username
options.description: The LDAP username used to authenticate (for ldap_auth).

options.name: login_data
options.description: Login data from a previous C(infisical.vault.login) operation. When provided, the access token from the login data will be used, avoiding re-authentication. This should be a dictionary containing C(url) and C(access_token) keys.

options.name: max_ttl
options.description: The new maximum time to live for leases. Example values are "24h", "7d".

options.name: metadata
options.description: Updated list of metadata items with 'key' and 'value'.

options.name: name
options.description: The current name of the dynamic secret to update.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name for the dynamic secret (if renaming).

options.name: path
options.description: The folder path where the dynamic secret is located. For example: /services/backend

options.name: project_slug
options.description: The slug of the project containing the dynamic secret.

options.name: token
options.description: An access token used to authenticate with Infisical. This can be either a Machine Identity Token Auth token or a User JWT token. Both token types can be used interchangeably with this field.

options.name: universal_auth_client_id
options.description: The Machine Identity Client ID used to authenticate (for universal_auth).

options.name: universal_auth_client_secret
options.description: The Machine Identity Client Secret used to authenticate (for universal_auth).

options.name: url
options.description: Point to your self-hosted instance of Infisical.

options.name: username_template
options.description: The new username template for the dynamic secret.
